subject: Makefile respect user's SERVER_CFLAGS and OPT (#55)
reason: The change only touches src/Makefile: it moves the default -flto/-fno-omit-frame-pointer flags from SERVER_CFLAGS/SERVER_LDFLAGS into the OPTIMIZATION variable and adds $(OPT) to FINAL_LDFLAGS, so user-provided SERVER_CFLAGS and OPT are no longer clobbered by defaults. This is a build-system change with no runtime behaviour change in the server, its commands, replication, persistence or tools; a default build produces an equivalent binary. There is no code path a fuzzer scenario could reach, so no scenario is needed.
